content: भ्रामर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [भ्रमरेण संभृतं भ्रमरस्येदं वा अण्] Relating to a bee. .{@-रः, -रम्@} A kind of loadstone. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Whirling round. .²2 Giddiness. .²3 Epilepsy. .²4 Honey; निर्मलं स्फटिकाभं यत् तन्मधु भ्रामरं स्मृतम् <ls>Bhāva P.</ls> .²5 A kind of coitus or mode of sexual enjoyment. .²6 A village. .{@-री@} .²1 An epithet of Durgā. .²2 Going round, walking round from left to right; (= प्रदक्षिणा <ab>q. v.</ab>); as in दीयतां भ्रामर्यः <ls>Karpūr. 4</ls>; <ls>Vb. 2</ls>.
